Name: Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)
Author: siamece
Description:
[center][/center][left][img]https://i.imgur.com/B3pqp0R.png[/img]﻿

﻿﻿This mod edits each portrait to smooth them out and make the artstyle consistent. Every character's portrait has been touched up, but their designs remain (mostly) the same!

Part of my Facelift series that also includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9097]Pet Facelift[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8591]SVE Facelift[/url]﻿.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]
SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿ are required. Hit download, then unzip/extract the file into your Stardew mods folder!

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                 [/u]
[size=4]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uUcgk6G.png[/img]﻿[u][/u][/size]

Your config file will generate once you run the game, or you can use GMCM for editing!
My edits can be turned off for any villager by changing their config from "[b]normal[/b]" to "[b]off[/b]". besides that, i've listed the fun config options below:

[b]Abigail - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]goth[b] / [/b]black hair
[b]Sam - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]short hair
[b]Harvey - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]no mustache
[b]Emily - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]short hair [b]/[/b] long hair
[b]Maru - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]curly[b] / [/b]braids[/left][b]Haley - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]short hair[b] / [/b]goth
[b]Sebastian - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]ginger
[b]Penny - [/b]normal [b]/ [/b]goth
[b]Elliott -[/b] normal [b]/[/b] short hair
[b]Wizard - [/b]normal[b] / [/b]cute
[b]Henchman -[/b] normal[b] /[/b] cute
[b]Krobus -[/b] normal [b]/[/b] cute
